title: Imperator Vandal
extract:
The Imperator Vandal is the Vandal form of the  Imperator heavy machine Archgun, sporting a higher maximum fire rate, larger magazine size, and faster ammo regeneration.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Impact damage.
Innate  polarity.
Advantages over other Archgun (Atmosphere)   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Fastest fire rate of all Archguns once fully spooled up.
Short reload delay of 0.25 seconds from empty, 0.15 seconds when not.
Tied with  Mausolon for the largest magazine size of all Archguns.
Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Above average crit chance (28.00%)
High burst DPS (3480)
Very high sustained DPS (2982.85)
Very high magazine size (300)
High reload speed (2.00 s)
Very high ammo max (1,200)
Very high fire rate (25.00 attacks/sec)
High crit multiplier (2.40x)
Disadvantages over other Archgun (Atmosphere)   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Tied with Imperator for the lowest base damage of all Archguns.
Requires a spool-up of 16 shots to reach maximum fire rate.
Fire rate starts at 53.33% of the listed value, and increases by 3.11% per shot.
Archwing:
Has linear damage falloff from 100% to ?% from 100m to 350m target distance (distances are affected by Projectile Speed).
Atmosphere:
Sub-par ammo efficiency, generating medium-high cooldown for the Archgun Deployer for every second fired.
Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Very low total damage (100)
Very low status chance (12.00%)
Low damage per shot (139.2)
See WARFRAME Wiki:Stat Comparison/Percentiles for more details.

 Imperator Vandal (Normal Attack), compared to  Imperator (Normal Attack):
Equal base damage

Higher sustained DPS (1265.45 vs. 752.60)

Larger magazine (300 vs. 200)

Higher Mastery Rank required (5 vs. 0)
Lower disposition (●●●○○ (0.95x) vs. ●●●○○ (1.10x))

Acquisition
The Imperator Vandal was awarded during the Operation: Eyes of Blight event for obtaining 15 (PC)/10 (PS4/XB1) Battle Points, complete with a free weapon slot and a pre-installed Orokin Catalyst.
The blueprint and parts are now obtainable from the Balor Fomorian Invasion via Fomorian Sabotage. All components can be traded.

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.
See Mission Rewards#Standard Missions for definitions on reward table rotations.
For more detailed definitions and information,
visit here.

Notes
Has a reload delay of 0.15 seconds while there is still ammo in the magazine. Reload from empty has a delay of 0.25 seconds.
Unlike its standard version, the Imperator Vandal has fire rate spool-up, allowing it to reach a maximum fire rate 50% higher than that of the  Imperator. This makes the Imperator Vandal the third Event weapon to have an additional hidden feature over its original version, after  Snipetron Vandal and  Latron Wraith.

Trivia
The Imperator Vandal is the first Vandal Archgun weapon released.
The Imperator Vandal was leaked as an entry in a player's Profile under Equipment, along with the  Mara Detron,  before it was revealed to be a reward for the Operation Eyes of Blight event.
The Imperator Vandal is the first event weapon that can be built using component parts.
In Hotfix 18.12.1 (2016-05-17) all future and existing Imperator Vandal blueprints and parts were made tradable.
